dedupe_keys.name: finnish slag concrete accelerated carbonation tests

description: The Tampere concrete-durability researchers tested 48 concrete mixes with different binders, water-to-binder ratios and air-entrainment settings. The Data in Brief article describes four cement types with ground granulated blast-furnace slag proportions from zero to 72 percent, exposed to accelerated carbonation near three percent carbon dioxide. Zenodo lists six public Excel tables for mix and material properties, exposure timing, drying and chamber conditions, measured carbonation depth and fitted rates. Forty-eight ZIP archives hold photographs of each mix; the repository states CC BY 4.0. Coverage is controlled laboratory material testing in Finland, not decades of outdoor deterioration or a stock survey of actual buildings. Accelerated exposure, specimen preparation and the fitted-rate method are known limitations when transferring results to service-life estimates. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating a carbonation-dependent degradation component in reinforced-concrete asset simulations. model-opensees is a related structural simulation tool, but no deterioration law or test data were converted to its inputs. The six workbooks and image archives were listed from metadata only; none was downloaded or checked.
